analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sparta host NEC, who travel to Armenia in the Europa League five days later. Sparta lost 3-1 at ADO and went out of the cup, and one report says keeper Brouwer injured his ankle; NEC came into the break on two league wins and a European win.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. I lean a little higher: Sparta conceded three at ADO and may still be without Brouwer, and NEC's attack around Dusan Tadic has scored six in two games.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.7 corners. Both teams attack down the flanks, but nothing in the news changes that; I keep it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.8 cards. No rivalry or bans stand out, and the figure is already on the high side for a mid-table game.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.5 shots, with NEC taking more. That fits an NEC side that has been on the front foot, so I agree.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.8 shots on target. NEC's form supports it, and Sparta created enough at ADO to hit the post; I keep the estimate.
